verdict.summary: ACCEPTED AT THIS UNIT SCOPE; NO REQUIRED FIXES. Review01 RQ-A1 is resolved: every previously surviving meaningful mutant (T02, T04-T08, T12-T20, T26, T30) is now killed by the permanent unit tests or adopted regressions. The three behaviour changes preserve intended semantics under independent probes. OSError becomes exactly ASSET_FILESYSTEM, keeping the cause and without masking other refusals, retries or programming errors. The aggregate bound is enforced before reading a member that would exceed it, and the post-read and final checks are retained. Windows device basenames with any extension are refused on disk and in the root, manifest and role paths. Remaining items are advisories and explicit integration duties.
verdict.reviewScope: Conditional unit acceptance of the enumerator and interop trial with synthetic fixtures; exact tests do not prove atomic snapshots under concurrent malicious writers.

d01_typed_filesystem.detail: Each case refuses with args exactly ('ASSET_FILESYSTEM',), keeps the OSError as __cause__, and leaks no descriptor: member swapped to symlink (ELOOP), removed (ENOENT), directory swapped to symlink (ENOTDIR), unreadable member (EACCES), untraversable directory (EACCES), and a closed root descriptor. UNDECLARED_FILE and PROJECTIONS codes are unchanged, InterruptedError is still retried to success, and a non-integer root still escapes as TypeError (not masked).

d02_aggregate_precheck.detail: With three 16MiB members, bytes read per member are a=16777216, b=16777216, c=0. With patched limits: total accepts; total-1 refuses after reading (manifest-inclusive final check); 20 reads the second member and then refuses; 19 refuses with 0 bytes of the second member read. A single 40MiB member refuses ASSET_BUNDLE_LIMIT with 0 bytes read; a 16MiB+1 member refuses ASSET_MEMBER_LIMIT. Growth between the pre-check and the read is refused by the retained post-read check.

d03_windows_names.detail: 88 reserved variants refused (bare, .txt, .tar.gz, .js.map), including reserved directory segments, root and manifest path, and on-disk aux.css, nul/ and com1.tar.gz. Neighbours admitted: console.js, conx, com10, lpt10, comm1, a.con, app.nul.js, nulled.txt, auxiliary.css, coms, com0, lpt0.

d04_final_byte_count.detail: A short read (5 of 10 bytes, then EOF) with size/mtime/ctime unchanged refuses ASSET_CHANGED; a zero-byte member with immediate EOF is accepted (no false refusal).

advisories.title: Windows multi-extension and set basis
advisories.detail: Permanent tests cover only bare or single-extension device names, so a regression that checks only the last extension (N09, admitting con.tar.gz) passes the permanent suite. Add one multi-extension vector. The set omits com0/lpt0, which a permanent test asserts are admitted; current Microsoft naming guidance may also list COM0/LPT0 (and superscript-digit forms, already excluded by ASCII). Record the chosen basis or add them. No Windows target exists, so this is not required.

advisories.title: Refusal-code precedence for very large members
advisories.detail: A single member larger than both caps (for example 40MiB) now refuses ASSET_BUNDLE_LIMIT instead of ASSET_MEMBER_LIMIT, because the aggregate pre-check runs first. Both refuse before reading; this is diagnostic only. Run the member-size check first if member-specific diagnostics matter.

advisories.title: Stale log and header prose
advisories.detail: The p02 detail label 'at most one member beyond the aggregate cap' is stale (the observation is 33554432 bytes and the assertion is <= BUNDLE_LIMIT). The adopted regression docstring still says 'Run: ... assembly_probes.py ... Review copy only'. Description only.

advisories.title: Typed filesystem assertion lives in unit tests only
advisories.detail: The adopted regressions' closed() helper still accepts a bare OSError, so typed ASSET_FILESYSTEM is pinned by the unit test (N01/N03 are killed there). Optionally tighten closed() to require the typed refusal.

advisories.title: Root evidence precision
advisories.detail: The retained root regression log records pycachePrefix null, and root-validation.json uses a 'reference-python' placeholder for two commands. This review reproduced both with the pinned interpreter and an empty private pycache prefix, with identical PASS results.

advisories.title: Diagnostic cause chain
advisories.detail: ASSET_FILESYSTEM exposes only its code through args/str, but keeps the OSError as __cause__ for build diagnostics. Any future serialized report must use the code only.

advisories.title: Carried forward from review01
advisories.detail: Change detection is timestamp-based and not a snapshot, and the runtime verifier does not check completeness at load, so publication custody must bind the tree (AA-3). The embedded verifier still omits subject-02 tests/filesystem.rs (AA-6). jsonschema is not byte-pinned, and the fixture digest comes from the same generator process (AA-7).
